newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota sees output loss of 70,000 units from fire.
newsitem.headline: Toyota sees output loss of 70,000 units from fire.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp"s production loss from a February 1 fire at a parts supplier totals about 70,000 vehicles, a company spokesman said on Monday.
The fire at Aisin Seiki halted the output of brake parts, forcing Toyota to idle all of its domestic vehicle production lines.

Toyota resumed production with its full capacity on Monday with a total daily rate of 15,500 units, Kamio was quoted as saying. Toyota hopes to offset the production loss within April by cancelling some holidays.
